thresholds.source: project battery gauge requirement; ADC leakage NOT specified in local docs -> ASSUMPTION

notes: RISK/FINDING: the 100k/100k divider has a 50 kohm Thevenin source; every 0.1 uA of ADC input leakage adds 10 mV at the pin = 20 mV at the battery. At 1 uA the error is ~100 mV (2.4 %). The exact ESP32-S3 ADC leakage is not in the locally available datasheets, so this is a conditional finding: measure it (or calibrate the gauge) before trusting the uncalibrated reading. C13 does not remove DC leakage. Mitigations: factory/field calibration, lower divider (e.g. 10k/10k costs ~210 uA), or a buffered/op-amp divider.
